#: The events case on the stand-in with scripts/legacy_click.json, under inputEvaluator=steamvr (--ini tests/conformance/ini/steamvr_evaluator.ini): the old input as SteamVR's legacy binding file for Index maps it (SteamVR's own file, or OpenLamina's built-in one where SteamVR isn't installed, as on CI). GetControllerState shows the right trigger pressed for the ten frames the script clicks it, its axis 1 at 1; the button events come as under direct (expect/events.json). Index's A is the old grip button (the legacy file maps a to grip), and the right controller's buttons and axis types are the legacy file's: system, application menu, grip, axis 0 and 1 (0x300000007); axis 0 a trackpad (its first source), axis 1 a trigger, axis 2 none.
